name: ayso13-weather-api
description: Cloudflare Worker that fetches Tempest + NWS data, computes WBGT, and serves /api/weather for the AYSO Region 13 weather page.

scripts.preflight:
node -e 'if(!process.env.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID){console.error("
✗ CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID is not set.

Wrangler may deploy to the wrong Cloudflare account on this machine.
Export the AYSO Region 13 account ID first, e.g.:

  export CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID=<ayso13-account-id>

Find it in the Cloudflare dashboard sidebar.
");process.exit(1)}else{console.log("✓ CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID is set")}'
